headline: After years of teasing and anticipation, J. Cole announced his new shoe the “Dreamer Indie
body: After years of teasing and anticipation, J. Cole announced his new shoe the “Dreamer Indie 5000” will be dropping tomorrow in Fayetteville (location available at dreamerinc.com) “5 years in the making. Took my time to make sure I did it right. Designed, developed and manufactured independently. INDIE 5000 available tomorrow in Fayetteville, NC.”.
